hook: Your boat on Lake Constance floats where no border is agreed.
title: Three countries, one lake, no agreed border
description:
Germany, Austria and Switzerland all touch Lake Constance, yet there is no officially agreed border line through the water. Boats cross it every day. Part of the series 'Places That Shouldn't Exist'.

#Shorts #Geography #LakeConstance
